name: Sea to Sea Dossier
description: Four-day tent plan for the Sea to Sea trail (Yam el Yam) from Achziv on the Mediterranean to the Sea of Galilee, 16 to 19 October 2026.
gpxDescription: Sea to Sea (Yam el Yam), Achziv to the Kinneret, 16-19 October 2026. Route from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

waypoints.name: NIGHT 0 · Thu 15 Oct · Achziv: INPA campsite in Achziv National Park, paid, showers, no dogs; free alternative the eucalyptus grove behind the Yad LeYad memorial 800 m north
NIGHT 1 · Fri 16 Oct · Abirim: free night camp with a tap and a bin at the village entrance, no toilets, 546 m
NIGHT 2 · Sat 17 Oct · Horbat Hammama: INPA free night camp, tap, toilets, fires in the marked spots, 886 m, cold nights
NIGHT 3 · Sun 18 Oct · Nahal Amud night camp: INPA paid camp at the upper reserve entrance, book online, check-in 15:00-19:00, taps, toilets, 530 m
NIGHT 3 option B · Pitul Meron: free night camp with tables and a tap by road 866, 2.6 km before the reserve gate
FINISH · Mon 19 Oct · Ginosar, Kinneret shore: -211 m, bus 59 from the Ginosar stop on road 90
PASS · Har Meron 1204 m - highest point of the trail; the line crosses the summit plateau, the peak loop is 15 min off it; tap at the summit car park
INFO · Betzet beach - free camping alternative north of the national park, no facilities
INFO · Yad LeYad memorial - tap at the entrance; eucalyptus grove behind it used by Sea to Sea hikers
INFO · Montfort castle - Crusader ruin above the stream; steps and a short scramble up, do not sleep here (reserve)
INFO · Ein Tamir - spring in a long cut tunnel; headtorch, waist-deep water at the end; last reliable stream water before the climb to Abirim
INFO · Har Meron field school - paid camp with kitchen, showers and toilets, 250 m from Horbat Hammama
INFO · Sechvi pools - upper Nahal Amud canyon: ladders, pins and handholds for 6 km; exit the reserve trails by 16:00; no drinking from the stream
INFO · Ein Koves - spring by the middle section; reports say not a usable camp, no tap
ESCAPE · Manot-Avdon junction - bus stops on road 89 at km 5
ESCAPE · Elkosh junction - bus stops on road 89, fuel station shop 200 m, km 29
ESCAPE · Hurfeish - Druze village 1.5 km north of the line, fuel station shop and cafes, km 34
ESCAPE · Meron Center bus stop - road 866, 500 m from Pitul Meron, km 49
ESCAPE · Safed industrial zone - bus stops on road 8900 above the flour mill, km 54
ESCAPE · Kibbutz Hukok bus stop - 600 m off the line, km 66
TRANSPORT · Achziv National Park bus stop - Nateev Express 22 from Nahariya station
TRANSPORT · Ginosar bus stop - road 90, Superbus 59 to Tiberias, 700 m from the finish
TRANSPORT · Hukok junction bus stop - road 90, line 59 to Tiberias, 1.4 km north of the finish
